individual_objects.name: Room wall
individual_objects.evaluation: Large uniform navy/teal polygons read as a vector placeholder around the painted props. Painted material, contour and scale relationships are missing.
individual_objects.refinement: Inventory suitable painted room sources; native per-screen coverage must meet the master rule.

individual_objects.name: Room floor
individual_objects.evaluation: The flat purple floor gives no painted ledge/contact hierarchy for Roshan or the work station.
individual_objects.refinement: Replace only this measured room material gap using a qualified source.

individual_objects.name: Six strata bands
individual_objects.evaluation: Six thick zigzag lavender bands cross behind every task. Their repeated straight geometry overwhelms the rounded painted objects.
individual_objects.refinement: A coherent painted cave/strata scene needs quieter value bands and authored irregular edges.

individual_objects.name: World invitation tray
individual_objects.evaluation: Solid tan rectangle remains flat and untextured, with no visual support for the geology invitation.
individual_objects.refinement: Reuse the exact painted work support if its world-scale composition can pass.

individual_objects.name: World invitation pan ring
individual_objects.evaluation: Plain circular purple ring on the tan tray differs from the painted rounded pan used inside the task.
individual_objects.refinement: Reuse the approved current pan painting with preserved aspect; inspect mounted readability.

individual_objects.name: World outlined shelf 1
individual_objects.evaluation: A thin square aqua outline reads as a target UI box rather than a painted exhibit or room prop.
individual_objects.refinement: Reuse a suitable painted tray/exhibit support without covering the touch target.

individual_objects.name: World outlined shelf 2
individual_objects.evaluation: A thin square aqua outline reads as a target UI box rather than a painted exhibit or room prop.

individual_objects.refinement: Reuse a suitable painted tray/exhibit support without covering the touch target.

individual_objects.name: World crystal silhouette cluster
individual_objects.evaluation: Large flat turquoise/lavender triangles have no painted rim/material treatment and remain visibly inconsistent with the new embedded geode.
individual_objects.refinement: Inspect existing painted mineral cutout reuse and world aspect/scale before generating.

individual_objects.name: World target ring
individual_objects.evaluation: Aqua target ring stays readable, but its heavy uniform line overlaps the guide/exhibit and lacks clear scene ownership.
individual_objects.refinement: Tune placement and weight after the exhibit painting is mounted.

individual_objects.name: Roshan geologist identity
individual_objects.evaluation: Established face, rainbow fin, lavender eyes and explorer outfit stay painted and recognizable at both widths.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve this approved identity family.

individual_objects.name: Roshan working contact
individual_objects.evaluation: Her crawling hands touch the lower-left floor while the river, fossil, pan and geode sit far above/right. The selected pose does not visibly perform the job.
individual_objects.refinement: Use a connected work pose and measured hand sockets; inspect the entire reach/work/release/return.

individual_objects.name: Roshan completion still
individual_objects.evaluation: Visible celebration is readable and preserves identity. Geode completion claps without removing its crystals; stills do not prove acting transitions.
individual_objects.refinement: Review the full transition/contact and ordinary exit; retain as an inclusive priority.

individual_objects.name: Geology guide artwork
individual_objects.evaluation: Painted purple guide, teal coat and magnifier retain a strong child-readable silhouette.
individual_objects.refinement: Reuse this established guide artwork.

individual_objects.name: Guide work placement
individual_objects.evaluation: The guide is visible but stands away from the objects; some invitation overlap with the crystal/ring remains.
individual_objects.refinement: Review guide placement and meaningful pointing/teaching contact.

individual_objects.name: River earth bed
individual_objects.evaluation: Broad painted cream/gold excavation bed with lavender outline/shadow contains the grid at both widths. This is a wide prop, not a qualified room background.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve complete authored canvas and review foreground/actor work context.

individual_objects.name: River spring and outlet bowls
individual_objects.evaluation: Rounded painted pools stay legible in the actual task; source sheet includes rejected unused connectors which are not passed by these bowls.
individual_objects.refinement: Inspect every actual joined shape and flow consequence.

individual_objects.name: Dry excavation joins
individual_objects.evaluation: Current visible joining uses matte gold banks and quiet aqua water rather than diagram circles. Small bank/value steps remain at some joins; reached the provisional floor in directly reviewed final/open states.
individual_objects.refinement: Review arbitrary corner/T/cross/isolated/restore states with the actual renderer; full timed stroke and actor contact remain open.

individual_objects.name: River held brush drawing

individual_objects.refinement: Inspect continuous actual stroke with hand socket alignment.

individual_objects.name: Fossil/pan/geode stone support
individual_objects.evaluation: Complete cream stone slab retains painterly edges, purple bands and authored aspect under the three tasks.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve this exact canvas; inspect actor height/contact.

individual_objects.name: Fossil image
individual_objects.evaluation: Rounded cream spiral fossil/brown earth material has readable painted separation and established palette.
individual_objects.refinement: Preserve the conserved source image.

individual_objects.name: Fossil soil cover

individual_objects.refinement: Preserve the exact current painted soil.

individual_objects.name: Partial fossil clearing
